title: XGBoost on T1-mapping MRI predicts cholangiocyte-phenotype hepatocellular carcinoma
summary: In 180 patients with histologically confirmed HCC from two institutions, clinical and gadoxetic acid-enhanced MRI features were screened with LASSO and logistic regression and five machine learning models were built. The XGBoost model reached AUCs of 0.835, 0.830, 0.816 and 0.776 in training, internal, external and prospective validation cohorts. Its predictions also stratified relapse-free survival (HR 1.986; 95% CI 1.061 to 3.717; P = 0.029). The cohort is small and prospective validation numbers are not given in the abstract.
ai_technology: XGBoost model (best of five) on T1 mapping MRI and clinical features, explained with SHAP

evidence.unknown: Prospective cohort size not stated in the abstract; two institutions; full text not reviewed.
